content.json:
## Clubhouse
Template version 1 · telemetry schema 1 · generated from the attribute registry; see docs/telemetry/workbook/README.md.

parameters.name: Version
parameters.label: App version
parameters.query: customMetrics | where timestamp {TimeRange} | where name == "clubhouse.app.sessions" | distinct application_Version | order by application_Version desc

content.json: Data from Clubhouse's opt-in telemetry export. Nothing here contains prompts, paths or names; see the telemetry spec §5.

content.query:
union requests, customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange} | where "{Version:label}" == "All" or application_Version in ({Version})
| summarize installs = dcount(user_Id) by bin(timestamp, 1d)
content.title: Active installs per day

content.query:
customMetrics
| where timestamp {TimeRange} | where "{Version:label}" == "All" or application_Version in ({Version})
| where name == "clubhouse.app.sessions"
| extend kind = tostring(customDimensions["clubhouse.startup.kind"])
| summarize sessions = sum(value) by kind, bin(timestamp, 1d)
content.title: Sessions by startup kind

content.query:
customMetrics
| where timestamp {TimeRange} | where "{Version:label}" == "All" or application_Version in ({Version})
| where name == "clubhouse.app.sessions"
| summarize sessions = sum(value) by application_Version
| order by sessions desc
content.title: Version mix (sessions)
Crash-free sessions

content.query:
customMetrics
| where timestamp {TimeRange} | where "{Version:label}" == "All" or application_Version in ({Version})
| where name == "clubhouse.app.unclean_exits"
| extend previous = tostring(customDimensions["clubhouse.shutdown.previous"])
| summarize exits = sum(value) by previous, bin(timestamp, 1d)
content.title: Unclean exits by previous state

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == "clubhouse.app.unclean_exit"
| extend crashed = tostring(customDimensions["clubhouse.update.from_version"]), previous = tostring(customDimensions["clubhouse.shutdown.previous"])
| summarize exits = sum(itemCount), installs = dcount(user_Id) by crashed, previous
| order by exits desc
content.title: Unclean exits by the version that crashed

items.name: Unclean exits by the version that crashed

content.query:
exceptions
| where timestamp {TimeRange} | where "{Version:label}" == "All" or application_Version in ({Version})
| extend origin = tostring(customDimensions["clubhouse.exception.origin"]), handled = tostring(customDimensions["clubhouse.exception.handled"])
| summarize count = sum(itemCount), installs = dcount(user_Id) by type, origin, handled
| top 25 by count desc
content.title: Exceptions by type and origin

content.query:
exceptions
| where timestamp {TimeRange} | where "{Version:label}" == "All" or application_Version in ({Version})
| extend origin = tostring(customDimensions["clubhouse.exception.origin"])
| summarize count = sum(itemCount) by origin, bin(timestamp, 1h)
content.title: Exceptions over time by origin

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange} | where "{Version:label}" == "All" or application_Version in ({Version})
| where name in ("clubhouse.renderer.gone", "clubhouse.child_process.gone")
| extend reason = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions["clubhouse.renderer.gone_reason"]), tostring(customDimensions["clubhouse.child_process.gone_reason"]))
| summarize count = sum(itemCount) by name, reason
content.title: Renderer and child-process exits

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange} | where "{Version:label}" == "All" or application_Version in ({Version})
| where name == "clubhouse.renderer.unresponsive"
| extend window = tostring(customDimensions["clubhouse.window.kind"])
| summarize hangs = sum(itemCount), p95_s = round(percentile(duration, 95) / 1000, 1) by window
content.title: Window hangs

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange} | where "{Version:label}" == "All" or application_Version in ({Version})
| where name == "clubhouse.process.eventloop_blocked"
| extend flow = tostring(customDimensions["clubhouse.blocked.flow"])
| summarize stalls = sum(itemCount), installs = dcount(user_Id) by flow
| order by stalls desc
content.title: Main-thread stalls by running flow

content.query:
customMetrics
| where timestamp {TimeRange} | where "{Version:label}" == "All" or application_Version in ({Version})
| where name in ("clubhouse.process.eventloop.delay.p99", "clubhouse.process.eventloop.delay.max")
| summarize delay_s = avg(value) by name, bin(timestamp, 1h)
content.title: Event-loop delay (s)

content.query:
customMetrics
| where timestamp {TimeRange} | where "{Version:label}" == "All" or application_Version in ({Version})
| where name == "clubhouse.process.memory"
| extend type = tostring(customDimensions["clubhouse.process.type"])
| summarize mb = avg(value) / 1048576 by type, bin(timestamp, 1h)
content.title: Memory by process type (MB)

content.query:
customMetrics
| where timestamp {TimeRange} | where "{Version:label}" == "All" or application_Version in ({Version})
| where name == "clubhouse.renderer.long_frames"
| extend view = tostring(customDimensions["clubhouse.view"])
| summarize frames = sum(value) by view, bin(timestamp, 1h)
content.title: Long frames by view

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange} | where "{Version:label}" == "All" or application_Version in ({Version})
| where name == "clubhouse.app.startup"
| extend kind = tostring(customDimensions["clubhouse.startup.kind"])
| summarize starts = sum(itemCount), p50_s = round(percentile(duration, 50) / 1000, 2), p95_s = round(percentile(duration, 95) / 1000, 2) by kind, application_Version
| order by application_Version desc
content.title: Startup time by kind and version

items.name: Startup time by kind and version

content.query:
dependencies
| where timestamp {TimeRange} | where "{Version:label}" == "All" or application_Version in ({Version})
| where name startswith "clubhouse.app.startup."
| summarize p50_ms = percentile(duration, 50), p95_ms = percentile(duration, 95) by name
| order by p50_ms desc
content.title: Startup phases (p50 ms)

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange} | where "{Version:label}" == "All" or application_Version in ({Version})
| where name == "clubhouse.app.startup" and success == false
| summarize count = sum(itemCount) by error = tostring(customDimensions["error.type"])
content.title: Failed startups
Update funnel

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange} | where "{Version:label}" == "All" or application_Version in ({Version})
| where name == "clubhouse.update.apply_verified"
| extend verified = tostring(customDimensions["clubhouse.update.apply.verified"]), install = tostring(customDimensions["clubhouse.install.kind"])
| summarize applies = sum(itemCount), not_taken = sumif(itemCount, verified == "not_taken") by install
content.title: Applies that did not take, by install kind

items.name: Applies that did not take, by install kind

content.query:
customMetrics
| where timestamp {TimeRange} | where "{Version:label}" == "All" or application_Version in ({Version})
| where name == "clubhouse.update.failures"
| extend phase = tostring(customDimensions["clubhouse.update.phase"]), error = tostring(customDimensions["error.type"])
| summarize failures = sum(value) by phase, error
| order by failures desc
content.title: Update failures by phase and error

items.name: Update failures by phase and error

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange} | where "{Version:label}" == "All" or application_Version in ({Version})
| where name == "clubhouse.app.safe_mode"
| summarize count = sum(itemCount) by trigger = tostring(customDimensions["clubhouse.safe_mode.trigger"])
content.title: Safe-mode decisions

content.json: Persistence integrity (spec §12 H1): the largest regression cluster since March. Any recovery or guard block deserves a look.

content.query:
customMetrics
| where timestamp {TimeRange} | where "{Version:label}" == "All" or application_Version in ({Version})
| where name == "clubhouse.persist.writes"
| extend store = tostring(customDimensions["clubhouse.persist.store"]), result = tostring(customDimensions["clubhouse.persist.result"])
| summarize writes = sum(value), failed = sumif(value, result == "failed") by store
| extend failure_pct = round(100.0 * failed / writes, 3)
content.title: Write failures by store

content.query:
customMetrics
| where timestamp {TimeRange} | where "{Version:label}" == "All" or application_Version in ({Version})
| where name == "clubhouse.persist.write.duration"
| extend store = tostring(customDimensions["clubhouse.persist.store"])
| summarize avg_ms = round(1000 * sum(valueSum) / sum(valueCount), 1), max_ms = round(1000 * max(valueMax), 1) by store
content.title: Write time by store (ms)

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange} | where "{Version:label}" == "All" or application_Version in ({Version})
| where name == "clubhouse.persist.recovery"
| extend store = tostring(customDimensions["clubhouse.persist.store"]), action = tostring(customDimensions["clubhouse.persist.action"])
| summarize count = sum(itemCount), installs = dcount(user_Id) by store, action
| order by count desc
content.title: Recoveries by store and action

content.query:
customMetrics
| where timestamp {TimeRange} | where "{Version:label}" == "All" or application_Version in ({Version})
| where name == "clubhouse.persist.guard_blocks"
| extend store = tostring(customDimensions["clubhouse.persist.store"]), reason = tostring(customDimensions["clubhouse.persist.guard_reason"])
| summarize blocked = sum(value) by store, reason
content.title: Saves blocked by data-loss guards

content.query:
customMetrics
| where timestamp {TimeRange} | where "{Version:label}" == "All" or application_Version in ({Version})
| where name == "clubhouse.persist.flush_barrier.wait"
| extend store = tostring(customDimensions["clubhouse.persist.store"])
| summarize avg_ms = round(1000 * sum(valueSum) / sum(valueCount), 1), max_ms = round(1000 * max(valueMax), 1) by store
content.title: Flush barrier waits (ms)

content.json: Projects, git, files and the editor (spec §4.7–4.9; regression hot spots H5 and H8). Query text, paths, branch names and git output are never collected.

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange} | where "{Version:label}" == "All" or application_Version in ({Version})
| where name startswith "clubhouse.git." and name != "clubhouse.git.status.slow"
| extend op = tostring(customDimensions["clubhouse.git.op"])
| summarize ops = sum(itemCount), failed = sumif(itemCount, success == false), p50_ms = round(percentile(duration, 50)), p95_ms = round(percentile(duration, 95)) by op
| extend failure_pct = round(100.0 * failed / ops, 2)
| order by ops desc
content.title: Git operations by type

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange} | where "{Version:label}" == "All" or application_Version in ({Version})
| where name startswith "clubhouse.git." and success == false
| extend op = tostring(customDimensions["clubhouse.git.op"]), error = tostring(customDimensions["error.type"]), timed_out = tostring(customDimensions["clubhouse.git.timed_out"])
| summarize failures = sum(itemCount), installs = dcount(user_Id) by op, error, timed_out
| order by failures desc
content.title: Git failures by type and error

items.name: Git failures by type and error

content.query:
customMetrics
| where timestamp {TimeRange} | where "{Version:label}" == "All" or application_Version in ({Version})
| where name == "clubhouse.git.status.duration"
| extend files = tostring(customDimensions["clubhouse.git.status.file_count_bucket"])
| summarize polls = sum(valueCount), avg_ms = round(1000 * sum(valueSum) / sum(valueCount), 1), max_ms = round(1000 * max(valueMax), 1) by files
| order by files asc
content.title: Git status poll time by changed files (ms)

items.name: Git status poll time by changed files (ms)

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange} | where "{Version:label}" == "All" or application_Version in ({Version})
| where name == "clubhouse.git.status.slow"
| summarize slow_polls = sum(itemCount), installs = dcount(user_Id) by bin(timestamp, 1d)
content.title: Slow git status polls (over 2 s, Detailed level)

items.name: Slow git status polls (over 2 s, Detailed level)

content.query:
dependencies
| where timestamp {TimeRange} | where "{Version:label}" == "All" or application_Version in ({Version})
| where name in ("clubhouse.git.worktree_create", "clubhouse.git.worktree_remove")
| summarize count = sum(itemCount), failed = sumif(itemCount, success == false), p95_ms = round(percentile(duration, 95)) by name
content.title: Worktree create and remove

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange} | where "{Version:label}" == "All" or application_Version in ({Version})
| where name in ("clubhouse.project.add", "clubhouse.project.remove", "clubhouse.project.git_init")
| summarize count = sum(itemCount), failed = sumif(itemCount, success == false), p95_ms = round(percentile(duration, 95)) by name
content.title: Project add, remove and git init

items.name: Project add, remove and git init

content.query:
customMetrics
| where timestamp {TimeRange} | where "{Version:label}" == "All" or application_Version in ({Version})
| where name == "clubhouse.projects.count"
| summarize projects = max(valueMax) by user_Id
| summarize installs = count(), p50 = percentile(projects, 50), p90 = percentile(projects, 90), max = max(projects)
content.title: Projects per install

content.query:
customMetrics
| where timestamp {TimeRange} | where "{Version:label}" == "All" or application_Version in ({Version})
| where name == "clubhouse.file.ops"
| extend op = tostring(customDimensions["clubhouse.file.op"]), result = tostring(customDimensions["clubhouse.file.result"]), error = tostring(customDimensions["error.type"])
| summarize ops = sum(value) by op, result, error
| order by ops desc
content.title: File operations by result

content.query:
customMetrics
| where timestamp {TimeRange} | where "{Version:label}" == "All" or application_Version in ({Version})
| where name == "clubhouse.file.path_denied"
| summarize denials = sum(value) by bin(timestamp, 1d)
content.title: Sandbox denials

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange} | where "{Version:label}" == "All" or application_Version in ({Version})
| where name == "clubhouse.file.tree.read"
| extend nodes = tostring(customDimensions["clubhouse.tree.node_count_bucket"]), hit_cap = tostring(customDimensions["clubhouse.tree.hit_cap"])
| summarize reads = sum(itemCount), p50_ms = round(percentile(duration, 50)), p95_ms = round(percentile(duration, 95)) by nodes, hit_cap
content.title: File tree reads by size

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange} | where "{Version:label}" == "All" or application_Version in ({Version})
| where name == "clubhouse.search.query"
| extend engine = tostring(customDimensions["clubhouse.search.engine"]), truncated = tostring(customDimensions["clubhouse.search.truncated"]), error = tostring(customDimensions["error.type"])
| summarize searches = sum(itemCount), failed = sumif(itemCount, success == false), p50_ms = round(percentile(duration, 50)), p95_ms = round(percentile(duration, 95)) by engine, truncated, error
content.title: Search by engine

content.query:
customMetrics
| where timestamp {TimeRange} | where "{Version:label}" == "All" or application_Version in ({Version})
| where name in ("clubhouse.file_watch.active", "clubhouse.file_watch.errors")
| extend error = tostring(customDimensions["error.type"])
| summarize avg = round(avg(value), 1), max = max(valueMax), total = sum(value) by name, error
content.title: File watches

content.query:
union
  (requests | where timestamp {TimeRange} | where "{Version:label}" == "All" or application_Version in ({Version}) | where name in ("clubhouse.editor.monaco_load", "clubhouse.editor.open_external")
     | extend editor = tostring(customDimensions["clubhouse.editor.bucket"])
     | summarize count = sum(itemCount), failed = sumif(itemCount, success == false), p95_ms = round(percentile(duration, 95)) by name, editor),
  (customEvents | where timestamp {TimeRange} | where "{Version:label}" == "All" or application_Version in ({Version}) | where name == "clubhouse.editor.save_conflict"
     | summarize count = sum(itemCount) by name)
content.title: Editor: Monaco load, external editor, save conflicts

items.name: Editor: Monaco load, external editor, save conflicts

content.json: Plugin activation and canvas loading (spec §4.10; hot spots H10 and H11). Built-in plugins are named; others are counted together as other.

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange} | where "{Version:label}" == "All" or application_Version in ({Version})
| where name == "clubhouse.plugin.activate"
| extend plugin = tostring(customDimensions["clubhouse.plugin.ref"]), origin = tostring(customDimensions["clubhouse.plugin.origin"]), outcome = tostring(customDimensions["clubhouse.outcome"])
| summarize activations = sum(itemCount), failed = sumif(itemCount, success == false), p50_ms = round(percentile(duration, 50)), p95_ms = round(percentile(duration, 95)) by plugin, origin
| extend failure_pct = round(100.0 * failed / activations, 2)
| order by activations desc
content.title: Plugin activations by plugin

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange} | where "{Version:label}" == "All" or application_Version in ({Version})
| where name == "clubhouse.plugin.activate" and success == false
| extend error = tostring(customDimensions["error.type"]), origin = tostring(customDimensions["clubhouse.plugin.origin"]), api = tostring(customDimensions["clubhouse.plugin.api_version"])
| summarize failures = sum(itemCount), installs = dcount(user_Id) by error, origin, api
| order by failures desc
content.title: Activation failures by error

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange} | where "{Version:label}" == "All" or application_Version in ({Version})
| where name == "clubhouse.plugin.activate"
| extend attempt = toint(customDimensions["clubhouse.attempt"])
| summarize activations = sum(itemCount), failed = sumif(itemCount, success == false) by attempt
| order by attempt asc
content.title: Activation retries

content.query:
customMetrics
| where timestamp {TimeRange} | where "{Version:label}" == "All" or application_Version in ({Version})
| where name == "clubhouse.plugin.protocol.requests"
| extend result = tostring(customDimensions["clubhouse.plugin.protocol.result"])
| summarize requests = sum(value) by result
content.title: Plugin module requests by result

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange} | where "{Version:label}" == "All" or application_Version in ({Version})
| where name == "clubhouse.canvas.load"
| extend result = tostring(customDimensions["clubhouse.canvas.load.result"]), views = tostring(customDimensions["clubhouse.canvas.view.count_bucket"])
| summarize loads = sum(itemCount), installs = dcount(user_Id), p95_ms = round(percentile(duration, 95)) by result, views
| order by loads desc
content.title: Canvas loads by result
